eventMetadata.context_description: Iowa State's elite defense, ranked No. 1 nationally in adjusted efficiency, anchors trader consensus at 64.5% implied probability to defeat Kentucky in this Sweet 16 clash. The Cyclones suffocated opponents in lopsided first- and second-round wins, holding foes under 55 points while their balanced attack thrives against guard-heavy schemes like Kentucky's. Wildcats advanced via gritty comebacks but exposed defensive vulnerabilities against smaller lineups, allowing 40% three-point shooting. No major injuries reported on official updates—Kentucky's Adou Thiero practiced fully despite a shoulder tweak—yet Iowa State's rest edge from an earlier tipoff and superior rebounding margins tilt matchup dynamics. Historical neutral-site trends favor the Cyclones' physicality in Big 12-style battles.
